items.label: Sample D1 passport renewal. This is a demonstration, not an official DS-82 application. All prefilled information is fictional. The eligibility confirmation and wording below come from the retained benefits-scenarios source snapshot; they do not determine current program eligibility.
Sample renewal eligibility confirmation
items.hint: For this demo, confirm that you have passed the renewal eligibility check. A full official eligibility screen is still required.

items.label: Have you ever been issued a Social Security number?
Social Security number
items.hint: Demo source snapshot: a Social Security number is required by law if issued; leaving it out can mean denial. The prefilled zeros are fictional demo data.

items.label: Sworn statement that you have never been issued a Social Security number
items.hint: If no Social Security number was ever issued, enter your sworn never-issued statement. Demo wording; official statement text remains to be qualified.

items.label: Passport photo
items.hint: Upload a JPEG or PNG image. Passport-specific size, composition and quality checks are provided by the demo host and are not yet proven by this package.

items.label: Demo privacy statement: this sample uses fictional data to demonstrate passport renewal review. Authorized demo reviewers can see the submitted answers and photo. The retained source snapshot requires a Privacy Act statement identifying authority, purpose, permitted sharing and the consequences of declining. Full official wording and routine uses remain to be qualified. Do not enter real personal information.
Also available by mail (DS-82) or in person (DS-11). This demonstration does not submit an official passport application.

Sample declaration for the demo: I have reviewed these answers and declare that the information I provide is true and complete to the best of my knowledge. The application will present the full declaration and a separate signing action before submitting my whole Response. Checking the box below acknowledges the text; it does not create a signature.
I have read the declaration and am ready to sign my application.
